name: Japan map: no GS World Congress after its first eligible era

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset after refresh') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'headless setup refreshed'

local id=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); if id<0 or PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetLeaderTypeName()~='LEADER_JAC_RYUKYU_SHO_SEI' then error('Ryukyu human missing') end; if GameCapabilities.HasCapability('CAPABILITY_WORLD_CONGRESS') then error('World Congress capability still active') end; for _,cap in ipairs({'CAPABILITY_WORLD_CLIMATE','CAPABILITY_RANDOM_EVENTS','CAPABILITY_DIPLOMACY','CAPABILITY_ERAS'}) do if not GameCapabilities.HasCapability(cap) then error('GS/core capability missing: '..cap) end end; if type(Players[id]:GetFavor())~='number' or type(Players[id]:GetFavorPerTurn())~='number' then error('diplomatic favor unavailable') end; if type(GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange())~='number' then error('climate unavailable') end; local wc=Game.GetWorldCongress(); if not wc or wc:IsInSession() then error('World Congress object missing or already in session') end; local initial=tonumber(GlobalParameters.WORLD_CONGRESS_INITIAL_ERA); local interval=tonumber(GlobalParameters.WORLD_CONGRESS_MAX_TIME_BETWEEN_MEETINGS); if initial~=2 or interval~=30 then error('unexpected GS congress timing parameters') end; JAC_COURT_WATCH={eraTurn=nil,congressEvents=0}; if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>=initial then JAC_COURT_WATCH.eraTurn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end; Events.GameEraChanged.Add(function(_,newEra) if newEra>=initial and not JAC_COURT_WATCH.eraTurn then JAC_COURT_WATCH.eraTurn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end end); local function congressEvent() JAC_COURT_WATCH.congressEvents=JAC_COURT_WATCH.congressEvents+1 end; Events.WorldCongressStage1.Add(congressEvent); Events.WorldCongressStage2.Add(congressEvent); Events.WorldCongressFinished.Add(congressEvent); Events.WorldCongressSpecialSessionBeingCalled.Add(congressEvent); return 'World Congress disabled; GS favor and climate active; event watch installed'

local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(); local initial=tonumber(GlobalParameters.WORLD_CONGRESS_INITIAL_ERA); local interval=tonumber(GlobalParameters.WORLD_CONGRESS_MAX_TIME_BETWEEN_MEETINGS); local watch=JAC_COURT_WATCH; if not watch or not watch.eraTurn or era<initial then error('initial congress era not reached by turn '..turn..' era='..era) end; if turn-watch.eraTurn<=interval then error('not past first potential Congress turn: eraTurn='..watch.eraTurn..' turn='..turn) end; if watch.congressEvents~=0 then error('World Congress event count '..watch.congressEvents) end; if GameCapabilities.HasCapability('CAPABILITY_WORLD_CONGRESS') then error('Congress capability reactivated') end; local wc=Game.GetWorldCongress(); if not wc or wc:IsInSession() then error('World Congress in session after autoplay') end; local id=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); if id<0 or not Players[id]:IsAlive() then error('human eliminated') end; if type(Players[id]:GetFavor())~='number' or type(Players[id]:GetFavorPerTurn())~='number' or type(GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange())~='number' then error('GS favor/climate path failed') end; return 'no World Congress after eligible era +'..(turn-watch.eraTurn)..' turns; favor/climate intact; turn='..turn
if IsReadOnly() then error('government read-only outside Congress') end; return 'GS government screen functional'
if IsReadOnly() then error('great people read-only outside Congress') end; return 'GS great people screen functional'
